      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes `invalidateblock` returning success when block disconnection fails and leaves the chain partially rolled back. Reporting success on a partial failure is misleading to automated callers, though `invalidateblock` is primarily an administrative and testing interface."
    },

      "name": "validation",

      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Propagates disconnect failure error messages into `BlockValidationState` so callers can detect partial rollback failures. The core validation logic is not substantially altered beyond error reporting instrumentation for callers."

categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Changes block invalidation and RPC error handling, touching validation and RPC without affecting mempool or transaction relay policy.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies `invalidateblock` in `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp` to reject invalidating genesis and return errors on disconnect failures.
categories.rationale: Fixes `invalidateblock` returning success when block disconnection fails and leaves the chain partially rolled back. Reporting success on a partial failure is misleading to automated callers, though `invalidateblock` is primarily an administrative and testing interface.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches `src/validation.cpp` to properly record failure states in `BlockValidationState` during `Chainstate::InvalidateBlock`.
categories.rationale: Propagates disconnect failure error messages into `BlockValidationState` so callers can detect partial rollback failures. The core validation logic is not substantially altered beyond error reporting instrumentation for callers.
